sourceProofs.fact: Search selects original pss%4; item/person subcase only after rnd%150<IQ. A goods discovery additionally requires odd rnd; source-approved bounded actor IQ1 therefore cannot discover goods. IQ>=2 is the exact existence boundary, no RNG value is reconstructed.

Person path selects current local Belong0 raw candidate; fixed bole-1==actor succeeds, bole0 adds IQ/110 gate; success changes Belong and Devotion70..99. This V30 bounded return module explicitly rejects any current free-person candidate, rather than pretending to validate this path.
Goods path reads current hidden raw items, original GOODS_CON at raw ID, accepts bole0 or bole-1==actor then SetGoods; only target32 supported in this scope.
Coin/food source amount10+rand%(IQ*2), exact10..2IQ+9; fixOverFlow16 uses ADD16 otherwise U16 wrap.
add_16 positive overflow saturates to65535. If already saturated, no-visible and economic branch worlds may coincide, preserved as observationally-indeterminate.
Original report may happen before AddPerson; this oracle does not identify report retirement from final inventory. Actor returns at end of SearchDrv.
SetGoods scans current local ToolQueue/Tools and flags first matching hidden raw ID with high0x8000 only.
GetCityDispGoods scans original local raw goods; no Set or global de-dup.
Original AddPerson shifts the first200 raw queue backwards from199, inserts at origin start and increments later city offsets; 200..1999 tail unchanged, no global PID uniqueness assumed.
DelOrder changes only OrderId255; all five uninitialized Search fields Object/Arms/Food/Money/Consume and unknown opaque fields preserved.

limitations: No local free-person acquisition branch is accepted in this bounded module; if ComputerTactic changes city6 candidates into that scope, stop without success credit.
All actual code/source/identity/whole observer and row streams require ROOT independent terminal binding; this pure module never certifies the whole runtime.
A matching Search effect does not prove original pss/random value; equivalent saturating worlds remain ambiguous.
The original report UI and MAKE paid/queued two-stage transition are handled by a separate pure MAKE/UI verifier, not replaced by this return model.
The current target discovery status does not mean item has been publicly gifted to a caster or that a high-level controllable caster exists.
